prompt: Translate this to French as a text to a friend: 'Hey, are you coming tonight? I'm not sure if I have time to eat before.'
expected: A casual text message using 'tu', contractions like 't'es', dropping 'ne', and filler words if natural.
actual: Salut, tu viens ce soir ? J'sais pas si j'aurai le temps de manger avant, en fait.
